description:
Mind Tired? | Veena Healing Music

If your brain feels like an open browser with 47 tabs — start here. Veena's gentle plucked harmonics literally close the tabs. Just listen.

Solo Saraswati veena (ancient Indian fretted plucked instrument) playing Raga Bhupali, tuned to 432Hz, with a subliminal Theta wave layer for cognitive rest.

🎵 What you'll hear:
- Solo Saraswati veena — ancient Indian fretted plucked instrument with gourd-amplified resonant body and sympathetic strings underneath
- Raga Bhupali — evening pentatonic raga, the simplest scale in classical Indian music. Gently peaceful and uncomplicated.
- 432Hz — healing frequency tuned to natural harmony
- Subliminal Theta wave (5Hz) entrainment layer
- Seamless looping texture, no abrupt transitions

⏱ Chapters
0:00   Settling — softening into the chair
12:00  Tabs closing — first quiet space
35:00  Mental clarity returning
60:00  Restful spaciousness
80:00  Gentle return

🧠 How to use:
Press play. Stop trying to think your way out of the tiredness. Veena's harmonic decay slows neural firing rate naturally — your mind softens on its own. Tea optional. Phone away.

⏱ Best for:
• Mental exhaustion / decision fatigue
• End-of-workday cognitive overload
• Pre-sleep mental wind-down
• Anxiety from over-thinking
• Restful background work (no analysis required)

📺 Subscribe to Raga Focus for daily uploads:
- Sitar, Sarangi, Veena, Surbahar, Bansuri and other Indian instruments
- Sessions tuned to specific healing frequencies
- Music for anxiety, overthinking, sleep, stress, emotional release
